description: ACES calibration samples: periodic diamond unit cells, t/a [0.20, 0.24, 0.28], Re [1.0, 3.0, 60.0], Air at 320 K, 96 voxels per cell. Campaign 3: firm up diamond Nu (D30 scatter 0.143 sits just under the 0.15 refusal line) by adding low-Re anchors and an intermediate Re point at the thick walls where campaign 2 only had Re 10/30/100. All Re kept under the Mach ceiling observed in 02r (Re 100, wr 0.28 -> Mach 0.151).
hypothesis: Diamond Nu scatter at thick wall ratios (0.20-0.28) tightens below 0.12 once the Re spread is filled in; if it does not, diamond Nu at thick walls is genuinely broad and the refusal policy stays honest.
expected: dpdx and H1 h per case (rows carry boundary uniform_heat_flux); fitted with `aces calibrate`, which takes the boundary from the rows.
rd_activity: ACES fast-tier calibration of TPMS heat-exchanger cores
